description:
The GLPI Agent is a generic management agent. It can perform a certain number of tasks, according to its own execution plan, or on behalf of a GLPI server acting as a control point.

The GLPI Agent is a generic management agent. It can perform a certain number of tasks, according to its own execution plan, or on behalf of a GLPI server acting as a control point.
This agent is based on a fork of FusionInventory agent and so works mainly like FusionInventory agent. It introduces new features and a new protocol to communicate directly with a GLPI server and its native inventory feature. Anyway it also keeps the compatibility with FusionInventory for GLPI plugin.
core:
* daemon: Avoid to sleep in a perl eval
* fix #1041: Fix a bug where we can loop forever waiting a forked process linked to
  a task run. The problem was identified on recent MacOSX systems.
* Little enhancement of service optimization handling on windows
* support new "features" option/configuration to be used as advanced configuration enabler
* Updated OAuth2 options to support a list of values separated by commas to permit
  setting a much oauth access as configured servers

inventory:
* Security Advisory GHSA-q2j6-54g3-jhcj: Validate credentials values doesn't contain
  any control character before using it. This invalidated any mysql configuration
  injection attempt from a compromised glpi server.
* fix #1226: Fix regression in network interface inventory on windows related to
  failing bluetooth inventory
* fix #1208: Fix localhost ssh pubkey inventory to limit requests
* fix #1207: Fix Parse::EDID warnings on headless linux system
* Updated pci.ids to 2026.09.24 version
* Bump Inventory task version to 1.27

remoteinventory:
* Don't use dll calls for bluetooth network adapters remote inventory
* Bump RemoteInventory task version to 1.11

netdiscovery/netinventory:
* Moved debug level iec61850 protocol debugging to debug2 level
* fix #1234: Update iec61850 protocol support to better clean resources. On windows,
  this fixes a continuous cpu load after netdiscovery or netinvento task run due to
  a not released thread.
* Refacto snmp session handling fixing context reset when using SNMP v3 and vlan
  context switching is involved
* PR #1219: Support bulk snmp requests via maxrepetitions, skip-bulk-support-discovery
  and bulk-support-discovery-oid options in "snmp-advanced-support.cfg"
  * maxrepetitions: if set to 1, the default, glpi-agent will test each device to know
    if it supports bulk requests and then use Net::SNMP library default for the device.
    If set to 0, force to use Net::SNMP library default as maxrepetitions value, usually 25.
    Can be set to any arbitrary positive integer to force maxrepetitions.
  * skip-bulk-support-discovery: if set to 0, the default, glpi-agent will try to
    discover if devices support snmp bulk request. Any other value will disable bulk support
    discovery.
  * bulk-support-discovery-oid: defaults to ".1.3.6.1.2.1.1" (mib-2.system OID)
    This option permits to set snmp oid on which bulk support should be tested if
    bulk support discovery is enabled (the default).
* fix #1229: Devices like SiemensSicam can answer with NULL or empty string on not
  supported oid. The fix makes MibSupport based on private oid check more reliable.
* netinventory task should not report snmp error when iec61850 protocol inventory
  was successful
* Support --iec-dump and --iec-file on glpi-netdiscovery and glpi-netinventory scripts
  to permit iec61850 protocol support debugging
* Support SKIP_CDP_ON_IPPHONE as possible value for "features" option/configuration to
  disable CDP support on port where an ip phone as been detected. It permits to report
  the port as a hub of 2 known mac addresses where a computer is connected behind.
* Don't use snmpEngineID free text as serial if known to be the model
* fix #1240: Enhance Siemens devices support while using SNMP v3 and which can answer with
  an unexpected usmStatsNotInTimeWindows.0 PDU report during connection validation.
* fix #1241: Enhanced GrandStream IP Phones inventory
* Bump NetDiscovery task version to 8.0
* Bump NetInventory task version to 8.0

deploy:

* Bump Deploy task version to 3.8
